p.title: Industry map product lines were English registry text on a Korean page
p.symptom: The role block printed each product's problemSolved from the registry (for example 'parallel AI training and inference') beside Korean labels.
p.root_cause: The renderer printed the registry string as is. The registry is English only, and editing it would regenerate dependent artifacts.
p.fix: industry-view.js carries PRODUCT_PROBLEM_LABELS, a Korean line per productId (22), restating the registry line without volume, share, customer or production claims. A product without an entry shows no line and never the English text. The registry mapping of MP Materials to an equipment node is left as registered.
p.violated_rule: Reader-facing text is Korean and is never a raw registry string.
p.prevention: ci-atlas-contract-check P1531: every registry product has a Korean line, the table has no unknown ids, the English text never reaches the rendered block, and a product mapped to a node shows its Korean line.
p.verification: The atlas contract check passes with the real registry. Not verified: wording quality of the 22 lines by a domain reader.

changelog: **산업 지도 제품 설명 한국어화 (P{P}):** 제품군 설명이 레지스트리의 영문 문장으로 표시되던 것을 productId별 한국어 표로 교체. 표에 없는 제품은 영문을 대신 보이지 않고 설명을 생략한다.
